summary:
Sophosia is a reference manager (a Tauri/Vue desktop app served locally) for PDF reading and annotation, markdown and Excalidraw notes, and project metadata. I saved all 5 views; each passed its replay check, but two have flaws.

Saved views:
1. **library-meta-info**: the Library table of papers with one row selected and the meta info panel open on the right (type, citation key, title, authors, abstract). **Flaw:** the replay screenshot shows the "Type" dropdown open, because the panel seems to put focus on it. I couldn't re-save with an extra Escape step because the slug can't be reused.
2. **pdf-reader-comments**: the PDF reader showing a highlighted paper, with the annotation comments sidebar and the meta panel.
3. **markdown-note-editor**: the markdown editor with the Mamba reading notes open (headings, LaTeX math, links, a blockquote) next to the meta panel.
4. **excalidraw-diagram**: the hand-drawn Mamba block diagram zoomed to fit, with the drawing toolbar and zoom controls.
5. **settings-general**: the General settings tab (theme, font size, language, PDF translator, citation key rule). **Flaw:** the meta panel next to it is empty, and I couldn't find a way to close it on this screen.

Open tabs and panel states carry over between page loads in this session. Opening the diagram, Related Items and Settings added tabs that show up in the tab bar of views saved later (diagram and settings). Views saved earlier aren't affected.

What I couldn't capture:
- **Graph view (Related Items):** it only says "Select a file in the sidebar", and clicking a project in the sidebar just collapsed it, so there was no graph to save.
- **Plugins tab:** it shows "No plugins", so I left it out as an empty state.
- I didn't try the category tree, the Added and Favorite tabs, or the workspace switcher.
